content.doc_md:
The HTML specification encourages web developers to use the UTF-8 character set.

UTF-8 covers almost all of the characters and symbols in the world!

ASCII was the firstcharacter encoding standard for the web.

It defined128 different latin charactersthat could be used on the internet:

ANSI (Windows-1252) was thefirst Windows character set:

The default character set forHTML 4 was ISO-8859-1.

Itsupported 256 characters:

### Code Snippets

```
<meta charset="UTF-8">

---

<meta charset="Windows-1252">

---

<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html;charset=ISO-8859-1">

---

<meta charset="ISO-8859-1">

---

<meta charset="UTF-8">
```
